proposal_title: Canonical Domain Model Provenance & Entity Completeness
domain_specific_rationale: From the AI and Prompt Engineering domain perspective, CP-001 correctly restores the immutable creative hierarchy: ShotVersion -> PromptVersion -> GenerationJob -> Take. In the flawed predecessor model, ShotVersion inverted this lineage by requiring prompt_version_id, which broke multi-model compilation paradigms where a single creative shot intent (action, camera motion, atmosphere) compiles into multiple provider-specific prompt variations (e.g. Runway, Sora, Luma, Veo). Crucially, CP-001 enriches ShotVersion with explicit creative intent fields (action_description, camera_motion, environment_settings, character_refs, style_refs, constraints, continuity_refs) which form the exact semantic inputs required by R05 Prompt Compiler to build the Layer 1 Semantic AST. Furthermore, making face_embedding_hash and lora_weights_uri optional in CharacterVersion and StyleVersion under custom_attributes removes rigid vendor assumptions, allowing modern diffusion, autoregressive, and reference-conditioned video models to be supported seamlessly.

capability_impact: Directly preserves and enhances CAP-01 (Canonical Core State), CAP-05 (Prompt Compiler), and CAP-06 (Assets & Continuity). Ensures prompt compilation pipelines have full semantic input fidelity and traceable end-to-end prompt-to-video provenance without capability degradation.
residual_risk: As new generative AI video models emerge with novel multimodal conditioning (e.g., 3D camera splats, skeletal pose sequences, audio-driven lip sync), new parameters must be passed cleanly. Mitigation: The schema provides extensible dictionaries in PromptVersion.parameters, PromptVersion.ast_snapshot, and CharacterVersion/StyleVersion.custom_attributes, allowing R05 compiler plugins to handle new modalities without breaking base schemas.
